authorship: Codex acting as fixture writer, using the existing synthetic shift-handover commission. No independent human editor or practitioner contribution has been verified.
decision: Choose the first internal web asset: a use guide for shift handover, or a terms panel for buyers checking specifications. No external publication.
buyer: Shift supervisor preparing outgoing batches; a procurement reviewer may have a separate information need.
observation: One shift supervisor used the two-tone tray to separate outgoing batches.
known_product: The passive tray has two separate compartments.
hypotheses: The supervisor understands the specification but cannot see how the tray fits the handover.
The supervisor understands sorting but needs specifications to decide whether to use the tray.
question: At the last handover, what did you try to find immediately before using or putting aside the tray? Show the step or document you used.
evidence_needed: Observe the next two eligible handovers with permission. Record the first information sought, a contrary case and whether the task stops. Convenience observations cannot establish prevalence.
switch_rule: Both observations request specifications first: hold the guide and propose a terms panel for a new decision. Both show sorting confusion: keep the internal use guide. Mixed or unavailable observations: hold and ask the commissioning owner.
authority_hold: No recruitment, customer contact or transfer of notes. A different audience, channel or asset direction needs qualification and review. A released guide authorizes internal drafting only.

decision_fields.buying_situation: A shift supervisor checks outgoing batches at a handover before separating them.
decision_fields.sample_limit: One synthetic observation of one supervisor at one handover. No frequency estimate or verified purchasing demand.
decision_fields.interpretation: Draft a use guide for this observed situation. Ask what was sought before using the tray. If both later handovers seek specifications first, hold the guide and ask the owner to review a terms panel. Mixed observations require a hold.
